method.method_draft: From the diagram, read that the square is split by one full-height vertical cut into a left strip and a right strip, and each strip is further divided into three rectangles by two horizontal cuts. Let the square side be s, the left strip width be a, and the right strip width be b, so a+b=s. The three left rectangles all have width a and their heights add to s; the three right rectangles all have width b and their heights add to s. Using the text fact that the sum of all six perimeters is 120 cm, compute the total as 2[(sum of all rectangle widths)+(sum of all rectangle heights)] = 2[3a+3b+s+s] = 2[3s+2s] = 10s. Thus 10s=120, so s=12 and the square area is s^2=144 cm^2.
